chunks.text: I’ve been mapping out a little food-and-walk kind of day in Chengdu, just wandering around and checking out a couple attractions while I’m there.
And for that other leg of the trip, I’m headed to Nanjing and I’m basically thinking hotel first, everything else second.
For Nanjing I’m staying at Hanting Hotel Xuanwu, checking in on 2026-03-06, and it’s under He Xia.
I’m planning to keep that Nanjing stay pretty steady—5 nights—so I don’t have to keep moving my stuff around.
Then in Chengdu on 2026-03-16 I’m doing Kuanzhai Alley in the morning—Zhao Min is the visitor name—and it’s 4 tickets, and after that I’ll probably just keep strolling until I get hungry and—
